messages:
Alex: Heads up — p99 for /v1/generate spiked ~03:12 on the latency dashboard, looks correlated with a queue-time tag increase.
Maya: I saw that too, only for a subset of endpoints (client=mobile). p50/p95 look fine.
Alex: Can someone check if we're double-counting proxy queue_time when we join route telemetry into rollups?
Raj: Can you paste the dashboard query or a sample rollup?
Maya: Quick snip of the rollup join: ```SELECT merge_tdigest(tdigest) as td, sum(queue_time) as q FROM route_rollups JOIN ingress_samples ON route_id=rid GROUP BY endpoint```
Sophie: If event timestamps aren't aligned before merging, TDigest compaction can end up biased toward late-arriving queue samples.
Alex: Exactly my worry — we may be merging samples from different event windows (ingress queue vs backend processing) and the backend time gets masked.
DeployBot: ingest-service/rollup-processor finished compaction job job_2026_03_05_0310 (status: SUCCESS)
Raj: Also spotted a burst of synthetic traffic from our canary harness at 03:11 — labels: origin=chaos-test. Could be injected samples.
Maya: Reproduced locally: filter out origin=chaos-test and p99 drops ~3x.
Sophie: Workaround for dashboard: add filter "exclude tag: origin=chaos-test" and add a split by sample_source.
Alex: Can we run a diff: p99(all) vs p99(exclude queue_time) to confirm queue contribution?
Raj: Doing that now...
Raj: Diff results — p99(all)=720ms, p99(exclude queue_time)=240ms, p95 unchanged (~120ms).
Alex: That points to queue_time samples inflating the tail. Smoking gun.
Maya: Proposal: when merging rollups, align by event_time window and preserve sample_source tag; we should also avoid adding queue_time into the same sample blob used for tdigest.
Sophie: UX follow-up: surface a small badge in latency pane: "percentile provenance" -> shows which sample buckets contributed (ingress/backend/queue).
Alex: Ops ask: can we backfill a pre-filtered dashboard for customers until fix lands?
Maya: I'll open PR to: (1) preserve sample_source on rollup merge, (2) drop queue_time from tdigest input, and (3) add provenance tag metadata.
Maya: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/3456 (draft)
DeployBot: PR 3456 pipeline started — unit tests running
Raj: Quick note — ensure we have unit coverage for eventtime alignment logic, and a small performance test so we don't regress compaction latency.
Maya: Agree, will add tests.
Sophie: For the console, I'll sketch UI toggle for "show sample sources" and add a help tooltip about small-sample noise on tails.
Alex: Plan: Maya lands backend change in staging, run A/B on 4% of traffic, validate p99 down and no regression on p50/p95. If good, promote next Tuesday.
Maya: Marking owners: backend=maya, telemetry=raj, console=sophie, validation=alex.
Alex: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sophie: Filing a short runbook note for oncall: how to triage queue-inflated tails.
Maya: PR pipeline passed — staging deploy queued.
Alex: Great — will monitor the canary and update the dashboard when we have numbers.
